mechanism_narrative: The sharp and sustained decline in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last four weeks, culminating in a significant drop in the most recent week, indicates a strong downward trend that will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating a reversal of the observed trend.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, as observed in the latest data, signifies a widespread shift towards staying at home, which directly reduces engagement in retail and recreation activities over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 4 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining elevated or increasing further.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent sharp declines in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicate a significant reduction in commuting and general movement across the city, which will inevitably lead to lower footfall and spending in retail and recreation venues over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain significantly below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous sharp drops across RETAIL_REC, GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES, coupled with a significant rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility, strongly suggests the implementation of strict lockdown measures, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a significant recovery over the next 28 days, while RESIDENTIAL remains high and other categories remain low, indicating policy ineffectiveness.

mechanism_narrative: The immediate and sharp decline in PARKS mobility, falling below -10% from baseline, indicates a strong public avoidance of outdoor public spaces, which will directly translate to continued low RETAIL_REC in the very short term, specifically over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days despite PARKS mobility remaining at or below -10% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The recent sharp decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, falling below -10% from baseline, suggests a broader reduction in all non-home activities, even essential ones, which will keep RETAIL_REC low over the next two weeks as people limit their outings.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains at or below -10% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of people staying home, evidenced by high RESIDENTIAL mobility, and actively avoiding public transport, indicated by low TRANSIT mobility, creates a strong and sustained disincentive for engaging in retail and recreation activities over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining high and TRANSIT remaining low, suggesting a decoupling of these behaviors from retail activity.

mechanism_narrative: An unprecedented week-on-week drop in WORKPLACES mobility, exceeding 20 points, signals a significant policy shift towards work-from-home mandates or widespread business closures, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES remaining significantly depressed after such a sharp drop.
